messages:
Noah (AE): Quick — Prospect ZenithBridge demo dropped streams twice. They hit a JSON.parse error mid-response and flagged as blocker.

Ivy (solutions): Which model / environment? Any proxies?

Noah (AE): hosted API, model=redwood-chat-small, stream=true. User on Edge browser; traffic goes through Zenith corporate proxy (Z-Edge).

Ravi (eng): suspect proxy idle timeout or transformation. Partial SSE chunk then connection reset -> client sees incomplete JSON. Any server 429s or 401s?

Marta (platform): infra shows proxy-initiated FIN at 2005001138 and nginx logged a 502. Auth service had a token refresh failure at 2005001136 for that session. No rate-limit 429s.

Ivy (solutions): client console from prospect: 
```
EventSource open
onmessage: chunk len=150
onmessage: chunk len=40 -> Unexpected end of JSON input
reconnect in 800ms
fetch error: net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET
```

Ravi (eng): Actions: 1) Ask Zenith admin to increase idle timeout to >=60s and disable buffering for SSE. 2) We'll add server heartbeats (comment lines) every 8s and `retry:1500`. 3) Ship SDK quick patch to buffer partial chunks and resume on reconnect.

Marta (platform): I'll queue a canary for sse-heartbeat change. deploy-bot: schedule canary.

deploy-bot: Canary queued for sse-heartbeat=8s (3 hosts).

Noah (AE): I'll send the short note to Zenith: explain proxy likely cause, ask for bypass test and interim SDK snippet.

Ivy (solutions): draft snippet for them: 
```
let buf=''; es.onmessage = e => { buf += e.data; try{ const o=JSON.parse(buf); handle(o); buf=''; } catch(e){} };
```

Ravi (eng): created ticket INF-1402 for SDK reassembly + auth-resilience.

Marta (platform): monitoring shows no repeats since canary queued (last seen 2005001158).

Noah (AE): thanks team — will follow up after Zenith tries bypass.
